scene.name: The Peacock Moon Bathhouse
scene.description: An opulent, unusual bathhouse with mineral baths, ceremonial water, lounges, steam and service rooms. Important pools and luminous sources are anchors; plentiful furnishings remain soft artwork.
scene.visualDirection: True overhead jewel-box bathhouse, iridescent peacock mosaics, lapis and malachite stone, mother-of-pearl shells, gold filigree, rose marble and milky turquoise water. Luxurious botanical motifs and luminous mineral details, no text, grid or perspective.

rooms.name: Moon pool hall
rooms.purpose: Ceremonial bathing beneath an ornamental lunar canopy.

features.description: Large square moon bath edged with pearl shells and filled with silver-blue mineral water
Pearl lantern with constant blue magical radiance
Gold-framed reclining couches, shell tables and bowls of floating petals

rooms.name: Orchid reception
rooms.purpose: Arrival, payment and selection of bathing oils.

features.description: Orchid planters, carved chairs, perfume bottles and delicate folding screens

rooms.name: Twin mineral baths
rooms.purpose: Two distinct bathing pools of warm turquoise and cool lavender water.

features.description: Square mineral bath with a carved malachite rim and softly coloured water
Low stools, towel stands, wash vessels and gilded shell ornaments

rooms.name: Amber steam room
rooms.purpose: Gentle steam generated by an ornamental brazier.

features.description: Pierced bronze brazier warming fragrant stones
Cedar benches, water ladles and amber glass bowls
Velvet daybeds, low tables, feather-pattern cushions, fruit plates and exotic plants
Mother-of-pearl cupboards, padded benches, robes and freestanding mirrors
Linen-covered massage couch with a jade frame
Oil cabinets, stool, folded towels and flower vessels

rooms.name: Linen and service room
rooms.purpose: Fresh linens, washing supplies and staff support.

features.description: Linen shelves, wicker hampers, water jars and utility tables
